task: Build the smallest owner-local setup path: install identity, launch Tower user-space on loopback, wait for health, run the already fixed harmless canary, and produce local evidence bundle without public network or secrets.

Build deterministic Python evidence-bundle exporter/verifier so installation.json and local_canary_evidence.json are hashed, bound to the active mission/authorization, and copied into workspace-local `.lidiya/outbox`.
Keep actual owner execution separate: Builder/C only test isolated fixtures and static Windows scripts.
acceptance: SETUP_SMALL_NEST.ps1 derives fixed workspace root from script location and takes no arbitrary workspace path or command input
setup runs existing INSTALL_SMALL_NEST.ps1, starts existing bootstrap_windows.ps1 in ordinary user space with no -Verb RunAs, service, scheduled task, registry or firewall change
setup polls only http://127.0.0.1:8765/health with bounded timeout; if unhealthy it fails closed and does not run canary
setup runs existing RUN_LOCAL_CANARY.cmd only after healthy Tower
EXPORT_LOCAL_EVIDENCE.ps1 calls local_evidence_bundle.py and writes only workspace-local `.lidiya/outbox`

local_evidence_bundle.py requires installation metadata and canary evidence, verifies them with evidence_reconciler, refuses unverified/tampered input, computes per-file SHA-256 plus canonical bundle SHA, excludes raw chat/secrets, and never marks E3 promoted
bundle status remains REAL_LOCAL_EVIDENCE_BUNDLE_CANDIDATE_UNATTESTED until online source observation/reconciliation
tests cover missing/tampered files, auth/root/id/hash mismatch, path containment, repeat export idempotency, no raw chat/secret fields, deterministic bundle hash
static Windows tests reject elevation, registry/firewall, service/task scheduler/public bind, arbitrary command or remote URL
prior Step005-007 verified artifacts are not modified except no changes; no model download/training, main/default, production, secrets, slot4 or canonical personality mutation
